$comment: Optional capabilities live in tools/, outside host discovery. skills/ exposes setup only. Dependency tiers describe actual requirements.

tools.name: project-board
tools.summary: Inspect and groom br-backed project boards; turn findings into actionable issues.

tools.name: audit-codebase
tools.summary: Assess architecture and module depth with concrete, ranked evidence.

tools.name: deepen
tools.summary: Repeatedly deepen modules, verify improvements, and reassess until justified convergence.

tools.name: ingest-docs
tools.summary: Turn existing Markdown into reviewable provisional DekSpec artifacts.

tools.name: recover-specs
tools.summary: Recover specification evidence from code and history with provenance.

tools.name: handoff
tools.summary: Prepare or resume a compact, verifiable work handoff.

tools.name: diagnose-session
tools.summary: Collect session facts and explain failures without altering the investigated run.

tools.name: interview-me
tools.summary: Resolve decision-relevant uncertainty before authoring or implementing work.

tools.name: debug
tools.summary: Diagnose a defect or failed check, preserve evidence, and repair when requested.

tools.name: prototype
tools.summary: Explore a design or interaction shape using explicitly disposable code.

tools.name: spike
tools.summary: Test a falsifiable feasibility question with a bounded experiment.

tools.name: setup-dektools
tools.summary: Choose optional tools, inspect selection, or repair their installation.

tools.name: security-review
tools.summary: Review applicable security coverage and findings without inventing confidence.
